context.body: The bounded canonical source is Matthew 21:33–46; its local speaker, audience, sequence, and literary form remain controlling evidence.

observations.body: Tenants beat servants and kill the son, the audience names their own judgment, and Jesus applies rejected-stone Scripture and says the kingdom will be given to a nation producing fruit.
observations.label: A vineyard parable brings leaders under judgment: action

observations.body: chief priests and Pharisees know the parable concerns them.

payload.posture: Read Matthew 21:33–46 as jesus within israel’s story evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The target is explicitly leadership in context, while “nation” and transferred kingdom have often been expanded beyond what the passage directly defines.
